name: xemu

saveDirs.label: Xbox hard disk image (game saves and snapshots)

biosRequirements.label: Xbox MCPX boot ROM
biosRequirements.note: 512-byte MCPX boot ROM (e.g. mcpx_1.0.bin) dumped from your own Xbox. OmniPC never downloads it.

biosRequirements.label: Xbox flash BIOS
biosRequirements.note: Flash BIOS image (256 KB or 1 MB .bin) dumped from your own Xbox. OmniPC never downloads it.

biosRequirements.label: Xbox hard disk image
biosRequirements.note: Your own xemu hard disk image (.qcow2). It holds the dashboard, game saves and snapshots. OmniPC never downloads it.

notes: OmniPC starts xemu with -config_path <data>\xemu.toml, -full-screen and -dvd_path <game>, so xemu boots the disc straight away and closing the window powers off the emulated Xbox and exits xemu.
The first-boot window (general.show_welcome) and the Windows update check (general.updates.check) are disabled: with the first-boot window enabled xemu does not load the flash BIOS or start the game.

Put the MCPX boot ROM (512 bytes), the flash BIOS (256 KB or 1 MB) and your hard disk image (.qcow2) in the OmniPC BIOS\xbox folder; OmniPC points sys.files.bootrom_path/flashrom_path/hdd_path at them before every launch. eeprom.bin is kept in Saves\xemu (xemu creates one if it is missing).
Game saves and xemu snapshots are stored inside the hard disk image, so back up the .qcow2 file.

xemu remembers button remaps per controller (SDL GUID). OmniPC applies remaps and rumble to every controller xemu has already seen; connect the controller and start xemu once first. xemu has no stick deadzone setting, and its menu is opened with Guide or Back+Start.
Official x86_64 builds require a CPU with AVX2 (x86-64-v3).
The OpenGL shader cache is kept in xemu's own folder (%APPDATA%\xemu\xemu\shaders) because xemu has no setting to move it.
assumptions: Verified against xemu master at commit 478b4f496102379c7eaa7f3ec10e714a703c4300 (tagged pre-release; latest stable tag v0.8.136) and genconfig 42f85f9a2457e61d7e32542c07723565a284fcd6 (subprojects/genconfig.wrap).

Release assets (releases/expanded_assets/v0.8.136): xemu-0.8.136-windows-x86_64.zip, plus -dbg-, -pdb.zip, arm64, macOS, AppImage and xemu-win-x86_64-release.zip (a copy, .github/workflows/release.yml). build.sh package_wincross copies qemu-system-i386w.exe to dist/xemu.exe with LICENSE.txt; .github/workflows/build-windows.yml zips dist flat without *.pdb. The build is a static mingw cross build (x86_64-w64-mingw32.static), so no MSVC runtime dependency.
build-windows.yml builds the x86_64 release with -Dx86_version=3 (meson_options.txt: required x86_64 architecture level), i.e. AVX2/FMA/BMI2; the debug configuration does not set it.

ui/xemu.c main(): '-config_path <file>' sets the settings file (xemu_settings_set_path) before xemu_settings_load(); a TOML parse error shows an SDL message box and exits; atexit(xemu_settings_save) rewrites the file on exit. On Windows without a parent console stdout/stderr go to 'xemu.log' opened relative to the working directory, and the log starts with 'xemu_version: <version>'.

ui/xemu-settings.cc: portable mode when xemu.toml exists next to the exe (SDL_GetBasePath); otherwise the base path is SDL_GetPrefPath("xemu","xemu") (%APPDATA%\xemu\xemu\). -config_path does not change the base path, which holds the default eeprom.bin and the GL shader cache (hw/xbox/nv2a/pgraph/gl/shaders.c: <base>shaders, <base>shader_cache_list).

genconfig cnode.h: update_from_table ignores unknown keys with a warning, rejects wrong types per key (Enum/String need strings, Integer needs an integer), enums are matched case-sensitively; generate_delta_toml writes only values that differ from defaults, with [a.b] headers and arrays of inline tables. OmniPC therefore treats a missing key as the default and writes default-valued keys only when another value is present.

config_spec.yml keys: general.show_welcome (default true), general.updates.check (true), general.screenshot_dir, sys.files.{bootrom_path, flashrom_path, eeprom_path, hdd_path, dvd_path}, display.renderer [NULL, OPENGL, VULKAN] (OPENGL), display.quality.surface_scale (1), display.window.fullscreen_on_startup (false), display.window.vsync (true), display.ui.fit [center, scale, stretch] (scale), display.ui.aspect_ratio [native, auto, 4x3, 16x9] (auto), input.auto_bind (true), input.allow_vibration (deprecated, true), input.gamepad_mappings[] {gamepad_id, enable_rumble, controller_mapping {a..dpad_right, axis_*, invert_axis_*}}. The internal resolution menu offers 1x-10x (ui/xui/main-menu.cc).

First-run prompts: ui/xui/main.cc opens the First Boot window when general.show_welcome is true and runs the Windows update check when it is false and general.updates.check is true; system/vl.c qemu_init sets autostart=0 and skips the flash ROM while show_welcome is true. Closing the window or SDL_EVENT_QUIT powers off without confirmation (ui/xemu.c).

system/vl.c qemu_init: bootrom must be exactly 512 bytes, flash ROM must open, EEPROM must be 256 bytes (generated with xbox_eeprom_generate when missing), hdd_path is attached as '-drive index=0,media=disk', the DVD drive uses sys.files.dvd_path unless '-dvd_path <file>' is given; remaining argv are passed to QEMU, where a bare path would become a disk drive. '-full-screen' is the QEMU option (qemu-options.hx) read in ui/xemu.c display_init. hw/xbox/xbox.c accepts flash images whose size is a multiple of 64 KB.
Disc images: ui/xui/actions.cc and popup-menu.cc accept *.iso and *.xiso. Hard disk images: the System settings file picker filters .qcow2 (ui/xui/main-menu.cc); qcow2 files start with 'QFI\xfb'.

Controllers (ui/xemu-input.c): mappings are keyed by the SDL joystick GUID, which OmniPC cannot predict, and created by xemu when a controller is first seen; controller_mapping values are SDL3 SDL_GamepadButton/SDL_GamepadAxis indices (south=0 ... dpad_right=14; leftx=0 ... right trigger=5); Y axes are inverted unless invert_axis_*_y is set; lshoulder/rshoulder drive the White/Black buttons (ui/xemu-input.h, hw/xbox/xid.c). There is no deadzone setting. The menu opens on Guide or Back+Start (ui/xui/main.cc), which is not configurable.

version.rc puts XEMU_VERSION in the VERSIONINFO FileVersion string. xemu has no option that reports its version and exits before the SDL/OpenGL window is created (QEMU's -version is parsed in qemu_init after display_very_early_init), so the smoke test does not execute it.
Not verified on a real Windows machine: the exact zip contents beyond xemu.exe/LICENSE.txt, and the toml++ string style (OmniPC reads both literal and basic strings and writes literal strings).
